name: Heard
summary: Done-for-you bookkeeping and taxes built for therapists and a growing range of health-and-wellness practices — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists: monthly books, quarterly tax estimates, annual filing and S-corp support by specialists who know the niche.
best_for: therapists and health-and-wellness practice owners — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists — who want books, quarterly estimates and filing handled by specialists who know their niche
skip_if: you are comfortable doing your own books in a general tool at a fraction of the price, or your business sits outside the health-and-wellness practice niche
honest_knock: Mind the fine print between tiers: the entry plan does not include your annual tax filing (a ~$750 one-off on Lite), it is annual billing only, and messy back-months cost extra as catch-up fees. Price the tier that actually includes filing.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-06 on their own pricing page) Three plans, billed upfront per year with the monthly equivalent shown: Lite $129/mo or $1,548 a year, Essential $169/mo or $2,028, Premium $255/mo or $3,060. Lite covers done-for-you bookkeeping, financial reports and quarterly and annual tax support for solo sole proprietors; Essential adds personal tax preparation and filing; Premium is for group practices and S corps and brings payroll in as an add-on. Annual tax prep and filing is a $750 one-off add-on on Lite. Two costs sit outside the plan price: catch-up bookkeeping, required when you join, at $99 for each month you have been in business this year (advertised in September 2026 as a 50% limited-time offer, and on 6 October 2026 as free for 2026 books in a World Mental Health Day offer), and payroll for S corps at $39 a month plus $6 per person. The 30-day free trial the page offered in September was no longer on it on 6 October 2026. Heard bundles business banking at no extra cost; its own llms.txt (read 6 October 2026) gives the rate as 1.00-2.50% APY, tiered, with FDIC insurance up to $3M through partner bank i3 Bank.

compare_with.why: Bench wins on general small-business bookkeeping breadth, a good local CPA on complex situations; Heard wins on therapy-practice specialization and S-corp guidance
